mainEntity.name: How long does a typical accent lighting installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accent lighting installation project varies depending on the size and complexity of your outdoor space and the scope of the design. A smaller, straightforward installation might be completed within a few days. Larger, more intricate designs involving extensive wiring, multiple zones, or specialized fixtures could take one to two weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial design consultation and site assessment. Factors like existing landscaping, power access, and fixture availability also influence the project schedule.
